verdict.rationale: Bland documents a first-party Triggers feature that watches for an event and acts on it, for example a support case being created causes an agent to call the customer. Event-driven automation is reinforced by post-call webhooks sent automatically when a call completes and by webhooks that pathways can execute at any point in a conversation. Missing for 10: detail on how trigger rules and conditions are defined, a list of supported event sources and action types, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: A trigger watches for something to happen and acts on it. A support case is created and an agent calls the customer.
Post-call webhooks are HTTP notifications that Bland AI automatically sends to your server after a phone call completes.
Execute webhooks at any point during the conversation
